continuity: Ju Hwaran has formally ended all contracts between the Yongbong Escort Bureau and Zhongnan except for Zhongnan's four-hundred-thousand-silver-nyang compensation payment.
Hwangbo Eom survived Taekyung's defeat but was left severely injured, requires at least a year of recuperation, and signed the compensation agreement under duress.
Ju Hwaran identifies thirty-three Yongbong Escort Bureau personnel who died during the current escort mission as members of her family and refuses to make further concessions.
The Beggars' Sect and Lower District Sect records show that some suspected incidents were not caused by Zhongnan, but their consolidated evidence supports the bureau's remaining claim.
Ju Hwaran has drawn her flexible sword against one final person connected to the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng substitution, but that person's identity has not yet been revealed.
Hyuk Sopyung publicly apologized on Zhongnan's behalf and said he would immediately report the matter to the Sect Leader and Elders.
plot: Taekyung, Ju Hwaran, Wolhwa, and representatives of the Beggars' Sect and Lower District Sect reconcile the evidence and calculate Yongbong Escort Bureau's losses. Ju Hwaran boldly adds disputed damages until the total reaches four hundred thousand silver nyang, while Hyuk Sopyung apologizes on Zhongnan's behalf and promises to inform its Sect Leader and Elders.

Hwangbo Eom is forced to sign an agreement voiding all contracts between Zhongnan and the Yongbong Escort Bureau except the compensation payment, then leaves severely injured after questioning whether Taekyung has crossed the wall. As the Zhongnan party departs, Ju Hwaran draws her flexible sword and declares that only one final matter remains.

active_continuity: Ju Hwaran has voided the Yongbong Escort Bureau's contracts with Zhongnan except for a four-hundred-thousand-silver-nyang compensation payment.
Hwangbo Eom is alive but severely injured after Taekyung defeated him and forced him to sign the settlement; he needs at least a year to recover.
Hyuk Sopyung has apologized on Zhongnan's behalf and promised to report the matter to the Sect Leader and Elders.
Thirty-three Yongbong Escort Bureau personnel died during the current escort mission, and Ju Hwaran regards them as family.
Some incidents gathered by the Beggars' Sect and Lower District Sect were not Zhongnan's fault, but the remaining evidence establishes substantial Zhongnan-related losses.
The person who replaced the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng with Hundred-Year-Old Snow Ginseng remains unidentified, and Ju Hwaran has drawn her sword over the final unresolved matter.
Tengwang Pavilion was substantially destroyed, and Zhongnan's conduct remains exposed to the Beggars' Sect, Lower District Sect, and Huashan.
The Zhongnan Sect's individual conspirators in the Yongbong Escort Bureau scheme remain unidentified.
Jeok Cheongang remains concealed beneath leather at Tengwang Pavilion in a suspended-animation-like state.
Taekyung remains publicly identified as the Fire Gate Clan's nineteenth successor.
Taekyung's Flamefire Path has advanced to seven stars.
Taekyung remains below the Supreme Peak realm but can defeat Supreme Peak masters through his physical strength, martial ability, and Fire Gate techniques.
open_questions: Who replaced the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng, and who is the final person Ju Hwaran intends to confront?
Which Zhongnan figures participated in manipulating the Yongbong Escort Bureau's failures and arranging the shipment trap?
How will the Zhongnan Sect's Sect Leader and Elders respond to the exposed scheme and four-hundred-thousand-silver-nyang settlement?
What further details will the Beggars' Sect, Lower District Sect, and Huashan records reveal about the two-year conspiracy?
What consequences will Hwangbo Eom's defeat and Zhongnan's coerced settlement cause within the Murim?
